title: Rheumatoid Arthritis CME postponed
summary: The academic programme earlier proposed for 3 October will not be held on that date. It has been postponed to November 2026; the revised date and programme will be communicated after finalisation.

title: AOS Hands-on AI Workshop completed
summary: AOS completed its practical AI workshop for orthopaedicians at Fairfield by Marriott, Agra, with Dr Anubha Karol as faculty and a reported attendance of 67 doctors.

title: AOS Foundation Day 2026
summary: AOS Foundation Day was held at Courtyard by Marriott, Agra, with orthopaedic trauma sessions, Memorial Orations by Dr C. S. Yadav and Dr Ashok Vij, and Lifetime Achievement Awards for Dr R. K. Goyal and Dr Ravi Sabharwal.
